==English== ===Etymology=== {{etymon|en|id=go}} {{root|en|ine-pro|*sent- (go)}} From {{inh|en|enm|senden}}, from {{inh|en|ang|sendan|t=to send, cause to go}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*sandijan}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*sandijaną}}, from {{inh|en|ine-pro||*sont-eye-ti|t=to cause to go}}, causative of {{m|ine-pro|*sent-|t=to walk, travel}}. The noun derives from the verb. {{col-top|2|cog}} Cognate with {{cog|stq|seende|t=to send}}, {{cog|nl|zenden|t=to send}}, {{cog|de|senden|t=to send}}, {{cog|da,nb|sende|t=to send}}, {{cog|fo,is,nn|senda|t=to send}}, {{cog|sv|sända|t=to send}}. Related also to {{cog|ang|sand}}, {{m|ang|sond|t=a sending, mission, message}}. See also [[sith]]. {{col-bottom}} ===Pronunciation=== * {{enPR|sĕnd}} * {{IPA|en|/sɛnd/|a=RP,GA,CA}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-send.ogg|a=US}} ** {{audio|en|En-uk-to send.ogg|a=UK}} * {{IPA|en|/sɪnd/|a=US,pin-pen}} * {{IPA|en|/send/|a=AU,NZ}} ** {{IPA|en|[send]|~|[se̞nd]|a=AU}} ** {{IPA|en|[se̝nd]|~|[sɪnd]|a=NZ}} * {{rhymes|en|ɛnd|s=1}} ===Verb=== {{en-verb|~s|~ing|sent|+,~ed}} # {{lb|en|transitive|ditransitive}} To make something (such as an [[object#Noun|object]] or [[message#Noun|message]]) go from one place to another (or to someone). #: {{hypo|en|emit|broadcast|mail|post|transmit}} #: {{ux|en|Every day at two o'clock, he '''sends''' his secretary out to buy him a coffee.}} #: {{ux|en|She '''sends''' me a letter every month.}} #: {{ux|en|Some hooligan '''sent''' a brick flying through the window, and the bang '''sent''' us running out of the building.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-06-14|author=w:Jonathan Freedland |volume=189|issue=1|page=18|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly |title=[http://www.guardian.co.uk/commentisfree/2013/jun/07/obama-apple-google-facebook-tainted-prism Obama's once hip brand is now tainted] |passage=Now we are liberal with our innermost secrets, spraying them into the public ether with a generosity our forebears could not have imagined. Where we once '''sent''' love letters in a sealed envelope, or stuck photographs of our children in a family album, now such private material is despatched to servers and clouds operated by people we don't know and will never meet.}} # {{lb|en|transitive|slang}} To [[get]] one going; [[move]] to [[excitement]] or [[rapture]]; to [[delight#Verb|delight]] or [[thrill#Verb|thrill]]. #: {{syn|en|excite|Thesaurus:thrill}} #: {{usex|en|I don't know what it is, but this music really '''sends''' me.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1947|author=w:Robertson Davies|title=w:The Diary of Samuel Marchbanks|publisher=Clarke, Irwin & Co.|page=183 |passage=The train had an excellent whistle which '''sent''' me, just as Sinatra '''sends''' the bobby-sockers.}} #* {{quote-song|en|year=1957|author=w:Sam Cooke|title=[[w:You Send Me|You '''Send''' Me]] |passage=Darling you '''send''' me / I know you '''send''' me}} #* {{quote-song|en|year=1991|author=w:P.M. Dawn|title=w:Set Adrift on Memory Bliss |passage=Baby you '''send''' me.}} # {{lb|en|transitive|internet slang}} To [[amuse]] greatly or otherwise [[stun]] by [[absurdity]]. # {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[bring]] to a certain [[condition#Noun|condition]], to drive. #* {{RQ:Lawrence Sons and Lovers|[[s:Sons and Lovers/Chapter 9|chapter 9]]|passage=“I suppose,” blurted Clara suddenly, “she wants a man.”
The other two were silent for a few moments.
“But it’s the loneliness '''sends''' her cracked,” said Paul.}} # {{lb|en|intransitive|usually with [[for]]}} To [[dispatch#Verb|dispatch]] an [[agent]] or [[messenger#Noun|messenger]] to find and return with a specified person or thing. #: {{syn|en|call}} #: {{ux|en|Seeing how ill she was, we '''sent''' for a doctor at once.}} #* {{RQ:KJV|2 Kings|vi|32|text=See ye how this son of a murderer hath '''sent''' to take away my head?}} # {{lb|en|transitive|sometimes followed by a [[dependent#Adjective|dependent]] [[proposition#Noun|proposition]]}} To [[cause]] to be or to [[happen]]; to [[bring]]; [[bring about]]. #: {{syn|en|bring about|bring to pass|set up}} ## {{lb|en|archaic|of a blessing or reward}} To [[bestow]]; to [[grant]]. ##* {{RQ:Shakespeare All's Well|I|i|passage=God '''send''' him well!}} ##* {{RQ:KJV|Matthew|5|45|passage=That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and '''sendeth''' rain on the just and on the unjust.}} ##* {{RQ:Scott Waverley|passage=God '''send''' your mission may bring back peace.}} ## {{lb|en|archaic|of a curse or punishment}} To [[inflict]]; to [[visit#verb|visit]]. ##* {{RQ:KJV|Deuteronomy|28|20|passage=The Lord shall '''send''' upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke.}} # {{lb|en|nautical|intransitive}} To [[pitch#Verb|pitch]]. # {{lb|en|climbing|transitive}} To climb a route without falling. #: {{ux|en|She finally '''sent''' the 12a after hours of failed attempts.}} # {{lb|en|slang}} To pursue (a course of action) committedly, enthusiastically, and often recklessly; [[go for]]. #* {{RQ:Twitter|en|date=29 January 2024|handle=JeffSullivan__|id=1752114773255172590|passage=There is often brilliance in just saying screw it. Acting on intuition. Following the gut. Just doing it. '''Sending''' it and seeing what happens.}} #* {{quote-av|en|date=4 Jan 25|author={{w|Trevor Rainbolt}}|title=you gotta be kidding|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-7UZX6WCeig|time=2:10|passage=Why is my first instinct Spain here? Like if I was playing two seconds I would've just instant-'''sent''' Spain on this. But I think it―there's a part of me that thought it could've been Italy. But, I don't really know.}} # {{lb|en|Nigeria|slang|intransitive}} To [[care#Verb|care]]. {{rfex|en}} # {{lb|en|UK|slang}} To [[call out]] or [[diss]] a specific person in a [[diss track]]. #* {{quote-song|en|date=2017-11-07|artist=Soph Aspin|title=Courtney Jade Reply (Freestyle)|url=https://genius.com/Soph-aspin-courtney-jade-reply-freestyle-lyrics|passage=But if you want beef, it's war. I'll rip you to shreds and '''send''' once more{{...}}And you think you can '''send''' for Aspin? Sort it, stop gassing.}} # {{lb|en|Singapore|transitive}} To [[give someone a lift|give (someone) a lift]], to [[drive]] (someone) to another place. #* {{quote-web|en|author=MPH Rubin (Judge)|date=15 October 2001|title=Public Prosecutor v Khwan-On Nathaphon|work=elitigation.sg|quotee=Khwan-On Nathaphon|format=Judgment Text, CC 4/2001, Exhibit P-131 - statement recorded on 15 June 2000|location=w:High Court of Singapore|text={{...}} After closing the door, I shifted to the extreme right and sat directly behind the taxi driver.
